text: 【三季度中国央行购金创四年单季新高】11月3日，世界黄金协会发布的2026年三季度《全球黄金需求趋势》报告显示，中国人民银行三季度宣布了63吨的黄金增持，为2022年三季度以来的最高。央行已连续八个季度实现黄金净增持，截至9月末，中国官方黄金储备增至2410吨，占外汇储备总额的8.5%。2026年初至今，中国官方黄金储备累计增加103吨，是2026年全球购金最为活跃的央行之一。
text_en: [PBOC Gold Purchases Hit Four-Year Quarterly High in Q3] On November 3, the World Gold Council's Q3 2026 Gold Demand Trends report showed that the People's Bank of China announced a 63-ton increase in gold holdings in Q3, the highest since Q3 2022. The PBOC has recorded net gold purchases for eight consecutive quarters, and as of the end of September, China's official gold reserves rose to 2,410 tons, accounting for 8.5% of total foreign exchange reserves. From the start of 2026 to date, China's official gold reserves have increased by a cumulative 103 tons, making the PBOC one of the world's most active central bank gold buyers in 2026.
